caption: The drawing features a single large, rounded, metallic or wooden object, depicted in realistic colors of brown and gray, with some dark and rust-colored patches indicating wear or age. The object has three elongated, oval cutouts or grooves aligned in a vertical row on its front surface. At the top of the object are two loops or handles, both roughly cylindrical and arching backward. In the upper left corner of the paper, a simpler line drawing diagram presents a top-down or schematic view of the same object, delineating the round outer shape, the two upright loops extending from the top, and the three interior oval slots. The main object is centered and occupies the majority of the page, while the diagram is relatively small and positioned to the top left. The background is a uniform light beige. The artist's signed name, "Lloyd Charles Lomahe, 1938," appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Deadeye
